question_text: Sketch a labelled multi-layer perceptron with two input nodes, one hidden layer of three nodes and one output node. Show the direction of information flow.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Two nodes in the input layer connect forwards to three hidden nodes, which connect forwards to one output node. Label all three layers and use arrows from input to hidden to output.

marking_points.criterion: Correct labelled input/hidden/output layers and node counts.
Forward connections/arrows in the correct direction.
